annotations.title: Where do buyers find options when they search?

description: Use when the user is planning go-to-market or channel strategy and asks where buyers look, whether to prioritise retail, review sites, their own site or communities, or who controls the first page for their category. Searches Google live for 1-3 buyer queries and classes every top-10 organic result by domain: retailers and marketplaces, reviews and media, brand sites, forums and social, reference, independent and specialist sites. Returns the share each class holds, who leads each class, and who takes the top three places. Domains and counts only. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one moment; compare: brand_domains, retailer_domains, media_domains; segment: q1-q3 (buyer searches). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For each brand's share of searches, use run_share_of_search. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/channel-mix.json
